environment: Disposable loopback QA workspaces with synthetic records. No live third-party sends, OAuth grants, repository credentials or financial transactions.
fixes: Branch-safe ORM document saves with atomic version checks and revision history
Branch-safe expired form challenge cleanup permits internal submissions
Failed initial form publication no longer reports a draft as created
CRM report grids expose all returned rows and keep their view state separate
Rapid search edits compose with grid page/filter/group changes; explicit resets and restored views replace search
CRM automation sample counts and rules replaced by permission-aware working configuration destinations
Workflow execution uses explicit field values and optional record ID instead of a hidden sample record; execution failures and skipped conditions are reported
Only failed workflow logs can be retried
Paused automation edits are labelled Save changes and retain their paused state
browser_evidence: 27 recorded final checks in browser-checks.json plus screenshots. Coverage includes document save/restore/reload, form publication/submission/review/export, report filtering/paging, hub destinations, workflow execution, and PMS status-triggered automation.
limits: Public-provider OAuth, real external message delivery and real credentials were not exercised.
Every possible role/option combination and permanent deletion of user records were not tested.
Concurrent unrelated edits remain in the shared checkout and were preserved.

backend_checks.scope: Document saves/concurrency, full-middleware internal form intake, shared forms, PMS automation rules and schedules
